senses.gloss: f., pl. קְרוֹנוֹת (preced.) open place for wagons on market days, station; market day.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 5b:1">Meg. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>רבי רחץ בקרונה של וכ׳</he> Rabbi bathed in the bathhouse of the station of Sepphoris on the 17<sup>ᵗʰ</sup> of Tammuz.

<cite ref="Ketubot 15a:2">Keth. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>נבעלת בק׳ וכ׳</he> if a woman had intercourse with an unknown man in the market; <he>בק׳ ס״ד אלא … בשעת ק׳</he> you cannot mean on the wagons in the market, but … at market time.

<cite ref="Ketubot 15a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>בק׳ … היה מעשה</he> the occurrence (recorded in the Mishnah) took place at the station of Sepphoris; Y. ib. I, 25ᵈ (in Chald. dict.) <he>בהן קרונה וכ׳</he> (not <he>כהן</he>).
